releaseNotes:
New Workspace desktop interface with separate PC and employee identities.
Choose your name: employee ID is automatic. Attendance, daily tasks and shift timer remain independent of activity tracking.
Fiverr, Upwork, Freelancer, website/direct project and task entry with USD/BDT values.
Employee blog drafts and review submissions; admin job, programmer application, partner and blog management.
Website visitor chat with replies, handover and tray alerts. Windows x64 and Microsoft WebView2 Runtime required.
Close to tray, reopen from shortcut, and update from inside the app.
